rejected_rule.statement: The engine, pump, and pipes at B are part of the machinery used for or in the working of the factory and thus pass to the defendant under P3.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "It is clear from D1 that the engine was regarded by the Company as part of the factory machinery, and from the evidence of Mr. Midelmiss that the engine, pump, and pipes at B were used for and in the working of the factories purchased by the defendant."
